devices.label: Switch

devices.name: R1
devices.cli:
!
hostname R1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 192.168.50.1 255.255.255.224
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 192.168.50.33 255.255.255.224
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 ip address 192.168.50.65 255.255.255.192
 ip access-group INVITES-IN in
 ip helper-address 192.168.50.34
!
ip access-list extended INVITES-IN
 permit udp any eq bootpc any eq bootps
 permit tcp 192.168.50.64 0.0.0.63 host 192.168.50.34 eq www
 deny ip any any
!
line con 0
 logging synchronous
line vty 0 4
!
devices.startup:
!
hostname R1
!
